messages:
Priya (Product Ops): Heads-up: scheduled deploy for the serving control plane next week. Target window: 2026-04-02 22:00 - 22:30 UTC. This is a rolling deploy of routing + autoscaler configs only — no model binaries will be swapped. Expected customer impact: short (~10s) request spikes and a very small chance of 503s for a subset of in-flight requests while nodes rotate. No data plane migrations.

Priya (Product Ops): Plan: canary rollout across eu-west1 first, then us-west1, then us-east1. Autoscaler config change to limit instant scale-ups (prevents thundering herd) and a new fallback routing policy. We’ll monitor token-level latency and error rates. If errors > 2% for > 5m we roll back.

Priya (Product Ops): Draft status page entry below — please review. Intend to publish 48h prior, and email customers with dedicated capacity 24h prior.
```
Status: Scheduled maintenance
Start: 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC
Expected end: 2026-04-02 22:30 UTC
Impact: Brief, intermittent increased latency and transient 5xx errors for a subset of requests. No model or data changes.
Notes: We will monitor and rollback if error rates exceed thresholds.
```

Alex (eng-oncall): @Priya thanks — couple of clarifying Qs: 1) Who is primary oncall during the rollouts? 2) Rollback plan details? 3) Any customers on Dedicated with active pinned tasks we should notify separately?

Priya (Product Ops): Good q's. Primary oncall: Alex (eng-oncall) will be primary for the eu-west1 leg; Jordan (SRE) will take us-west1; Alex will be on pager for final us-east1; backup is Sam (Customer Success) for customer comms. Rollback: disable new autoscaler config + immediate routing revert via feature-flag (takes ~30s to propagate), then scale up previous instances if necessary. If rollback fails, follow full node-restart playbook.

Jordan (SRE): Adding playbook excerpt:
```
# quick rollback steps
1) curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/api/flags -d '{"autoscaler_v2":false}'
2) /opt/tools/bin/routing-revert --policy previous
3) kubectl -n serving rollout restart deploy/serving-node --selector=region=<region>
4) verify: prometheus query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"serving\",status!~\"2..\"}[1m]))
```
Jordan (SRE): Also, add an alert runbook: if 5xx rate > 2% for 5m, page eng-oncall and set status page to "Investigating".

Sam (Customer Success): I’ll prepare the customer email. Need a list of affected Dedicated accounts + contact owners. Priya — can you drop that list here? Also, for high-touch customers we should offer a planned maintenance call time and post-mortem commit.

Priya (Product Ops): Good catch. Attaching list of dedicated tenants (private channel link) and will DM owners. Template below for customer email — feel free to tweak:
```
Subject: Scheduled Redwood Inference maintenance — April 2, 2026
Hi <CustomerName>,
We’re performing a brief maintenance window on April 2, 2026 from 22:00–22:30 UTC to deploy routing and autoscaler improvements to improve reliability. During this time you may see short spikes in latency or transient 5xx errors. No model or data changes will occur.
If you prefer we can schedule a brief maintenance call or delay the deploy for your org — reply to this email and we’ll coordinate.
Regards,
Sam, Customer Success
```

IncidentBot: Scheduled maintenance created: MNT-2026-0402-01. Affected services: serving-controlplane, routing-service. Notification window: publish 2026-03-31 22:00 UTC (48h prior). Incident page draft saved to /ops/maintenance/MNT-2026-0402-01.md

Alex (eng-oncall): Quick note on times: eu-west1 push starts at 22:00, us-west1 at 22:10, us-east1 at 22:20 UTC. I'll be oncall and SSH-ready for eu-west1 + us-east1. Jordan will own us-west1. If anything fishy within first 5 minutes of a region push we abort and roll back immediately.

Priya (Product Ops): @channel final checklist for publish: 1) Confirm oncall roster (Alex + Jordan + backup Sam) 2) Status page draft approved 3) Customer email list compiled 4) Runbook snippets verified 5) Slack incident channel reserved (I'll create #inc-mnt-1912345678). Once we hit all checkboxes I’ll flip the status page to Scheduled and trigger Prod-Comms-Bot to queue emails.

Sam (Customer Success): Checkbox 3 done — list attached. I’ll send high-touch outreach tomorrow.

Jordan (SRE): Runbook snippets verified. I tested rollback flag in staging; toggle time ~28s.

Alex (eng-oncall): Roster confirmed. Also suggest we set a short-failure window in the console: failure_threshold=2% window=5m. I'll push that to the config repo now.

Priya (Product Ops): Thanks all. I’m going to: 1) Create the incident channel 2) Publish status page 3) Schedule emails 4) Post the final announcement in #announcements 48h before. If anything changes to the window I’ll update here and ping paging. :white_check_mark:

Prod-Comms-Bot: Scheduled status page update will publish on 2026-03-31 22:00 UTC. Maintenance ID: MNT-2026-0402-01.

Alex (eng-oncall): One last ask — Sam, include this line in email for Dedicated customers: "If you run private deployments and require an out-of-band schedule, reply and we will coordinate a no-impact alternative."

Sam (Customer Success): Will do. Will also include the status page link and the optional call sign-up link.

Priya (Product Ops): Closing thread for publishing prep; I’ll reopen if we need to change the window. Thanks team! :rocket:
